description: Hash a single file — Returns the hash of a single file using the specified hash algorithm.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

base64.description: Set to true to emit the hash value in base64 rather than hexadecimal.

download.description: Set to true to force reading the data instead of using remote checksums.

fs.description: Remote name or path containing the file to hash.

hashType.description: Hash algorithm to use, e.g. `md5`, `sha1`, or another supported name.

remote.description: Path to the specific file within `fs` to hash.

name: operations_hashsumfile
